selection_rationale: Closed and open studio headphones that are standard in French studios, schools and broadcast (beyerdynamic DT 770/990/1990, Sennheiser HD 25/HD 600, Sony MDR-7506, Neumann NDH 20, ATH-M50x), two broadcast headsets with documented XLR3/XLR4/XLR5 cable options (beyerdynamic DT 297 PV, Sennheiser HMD 26), three in-ear monitors used with wireless IEM systems (Shure SE215/SE846, Sennheiser IE 100 PRO), and three headphone amplifiers from budget distribution to high-end (Behringer HA400, PreSonus HP4, SPL Phonitor x). IE 100 PRO replaced IE 400 PRO, which no longer appears in Sennheiser's IE family; AKG K240 MKII was dropped because no source could be read.
